newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Bus bomb blast kills eight, wounds 21 in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Bus bomb blast kills eight, wounds 21 in Pakistan.

text.p: A bomb exploded in a bus near the Pakistani city of Sialkot, in Punjab province, on Monday morning, killing at least eight people, police said.
They said 21 people had been wounded, nine of them seriously, in the blast in the Moza Shirwal area, about 20 km (13 miles) from Sialkot, near the Indian border.
The explosion occurred at 6:15 a.m. (0115 GMT) in a bus travelling to Sialkot. Many of the passengers were day labourers, hospital doctors said.
There was no immediate claim of responsibility for the blast and no word on its motive.
